# Getting Started

This is a minimal additional page used by the Playwright `additional-pages.spec.ts`
regression. The page exercises the additional-page render path so the spec can
assert on the resulting DOM structure (single `content-data` wrapper, inner
`cdx-readme` container, SPA fade-in behaviour).
